xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4212: Plan-freshness preflight refuses plans that create new files (false 'references files that no longer exist')

plan.title: Plan-freshness preflight refuses plans that create new files (false 'references files that no longer exist')
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan start refuses plans that create files, printing 'references files that no longer exist'. The preflight's isNewFile predicate asks `git log --all -- <path>`, which walks ~30k refs/pan/turn/* checkpoint refs, so any file a session ever drafted counts as tracked (PAN-1641's new files). It also has no time comparison, so a file deleted before the plan was written and deliberately restored reads as drift (PAN-4199's flywheelReveal.ts, deleted 2026-09-18, plan created 2026-09-25). Both needed --skip-freshness; on the auto-start path the refusal lands only in spawn.log.
narratives.Proposal: A missing files_scope path is drift only when a commit on the workspace HEAD history deleted it after plan.created. Probe with `git log -1 --no-renames --diff-filter=D --format=%ct HEAD -- <path>` in a new CLI-boundary module src/cli/commands/start-freshness.ts; keep the rule pure in src/lib/xbrief/freshness.ts (isDriftedPath, planCreatedEpoch); wire it into pan start replacing everTracked; document the preflight in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and reference/troubleshooting.mdx. Verified against the real PAN-4199 and PAN-1641 plans: current rule flags 1 and 4 paths, new rule flags 0; a post-plan deletion is still flagged.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Surfacing pan start refusals in the dashboard UI on the auto-start path (still spawn.log only)
- Changing --skip-freshness behavior, the formatPlanFreshnessRefusal text, or glob skipping
- Adding a new-file marker or any new field to the xBRIEF schema or planner prompts
- A parent-directory-exists heuristic
- Following renames to suggest a moved file's new path
- Checking files_scope against branches or refs other than the workspace HEAD

autoDecisions.summary: Use a temporal git rule (deleted on HEAD after plan.created = drift) instead of a new-file metadata marker or a parent-directory heuristic
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offered three mechanisms without naming a default. Parent-dir-exists masks real drift because deleted files' directories usually survive; a metadata marker changes the schema and every planner prompt and does not fix existing plans. The temporal rule fixes both reported plans with no schema change, verified empirically.

autoDecisions.summary: Baseline is plan.created, not plan.updated; absent/unparseable created means any HEAD deletion is drift
autoDecisions.rationale: plan.updated is bumped by later plan writes (lifecycle-io.ts:225) and would hide post-planning drift; auto-synthesized plans stamp created, so the conservative fallback rarely triggers.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the git probe in a new CLI sibling module src/cli/commands/start-freshness.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps execFileSync out of src/lib (sync-child-process and façade rules), makes the probe testable with a real temp repo, and shrinks start.ts, which sits exactly at its 1265-line file-size allowlist row.

autoDecisions.summary: Git failure makes the probe return null (path treated as a creation)
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches today's behavior, where a failing git log also counts the path as new; the preflight is advisory protection and must not block spawns on environment errors.

items.title: Add HEAD-only git deletion-time probe for the freshness preflight

narrative.Action: Create src/cli/commands/start-freshness.ts exporting headDeletionEpoch(workspace), which returns a probe (scope) => number | null running `git log -1 --no-renames --diff-filter=D --format=%ct HEAD -- <scope>` via execFileSync in the workspace; empty output or any git error returns null. Never pass --all. Add src/cli/commands/__tests__/start-freshness.test.ts using a real temp git repo with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE/GIT_AUTHOR_DATE pinned, covering the six cases in PRD WI-1 (never deleted, never existed, deleted at pinned time, renamed away via git mv, path only in a refs/pan/turn/x/y commit made with git commit-tree + git update-ref, non-repo dir). Exact code is in .pan/drafts/pan-4212.md WI-1.

items.title: Given a temp repo where a.ts was deleted in a commit dated @1790000000, headDeletionEpoch(dir)('a.ts') returns 1790000000
Given a path renamed away with git mv, the probe returns the rename commit's epoch seconds for the old path
Given a path that exists only in a commit reachable from refs/pan/turn/x/y and never on HEAD, the probe returns null
Given a never-deleted path or a directory that is not a git repo, the probe returns null
`grep -F -- "'--all'" src/cli/commands/start-freshness.ts` produces no output, so the probe consults HEAD only
Flag only paths HEAD deleted after plan.created and wire the probe into pan start

expected_outputs: freshness.test.ts reports all cases passed, including the pre-existing three-argument cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/xbrief/freshness.ts replace the isNewFile parameter with an optional deletedAtEpoch?: (scope) => number | null probe, export isDriftedPath(deletedAt, baseline) = deletedAt !== null && (baseline === null || deletedAt > baseline) and planCreatedEpoch(plan) (Date.parse(plan.plan.created) floored to seconds, null when absent or unparseable). A missing path is reported when no probe is passed, or when isDriftedPath(probe(scope), baseline) is true; existing paths never call the probe. Update the module header to state the temporal rule. In src/cli/commands/start.ts replace the everTracked block (lines 1159-1165) with a single checkPlanFreshness(plan, workspace, existsSync, headDeletionEpoch(workspace)) call, import headDeletionEpoch from ./start-freshness.js, and drop execFileSync from the child_process import (its only use was everTracked). start.ts must stay at or below 1265 lines (scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt). Extend tests/unit/lib/xbrief/freshness.test.ts with the seven cases in PRD WI-2 without changing existing tests. Before/after code is in .pan/drafts/pan-4212.md WI-2.

items.title: isDriftedPath returns false for (null,100), (50,100) and (100,100), and returns true for (150,100) and (150,null)
Given a plan created 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z, checkPlanFreshness reports a missing path deleted at a later epoch and does not report one deleted earlier or never deleted
Given a plan with no created field, checkPlanFreshness reports a missing path the probe returns a deletion epoch for
When called with three arguments, checkPlanFreshness preserves the old default and reports every missing path; the pre-existing freshness tests pass unchanged
`grep -n "everTracked" src/cli/commands/start.ts` produces no output, start.ts imports headDeletionEpoch from ./start-freshness.js, and npm run lint exits 0 with lint:file-size passing
Document the plan-freshness preflight drift rule

verify_commands: grep -n 'references files that no longer exist' reference/troubleshooting.mdx
grep -n 'deleted since it was written' src/cli/index.ts
expected_outputs: each grep prints a matching line
